narration:1:1826037001:1.text: A servant escorts Salazer out of the castle.

narration:2:1826037002:1.text: Once you are certain Salazer isn't coming back, you shed your disguise.
narration:2:1826037002:1.male: Once you are certain Salazer isn't coming back, you shed your disguise.
narration:2:1826037002:1.female: Once you are certain Salazer isn't coming back, you shed your disguise.

narration:3:1826037003:1.text: At the same time, Eryndor's crow returns to your side.
narration:3:1826037003:1.male: At the same time, Eryndor's crow returns to your side.
narration:3:1826037003:1.female: At the same time, Eryndor's crow returns to your side.

say:4:1826037004:1.text: Your acting was splendid, Magister Merlin.
say:4:1826037004:1.source_cn: 您的演技十分出色，着实令我惊讶，梅林阁下。
say:4:1826037004:1.male: Your acting was splendid, Magister Merlin.
say:4:1826037004:1.female: Your acting was splendid, Magister Merlin.

say:5:1826037005:1.text: Your talents would be a valuable asset to the Solitaries. Would you consider joining us?
say:5:1826037005:1.source_cn: 实不相瞒，隐士非常需要您这样的人才，何不考虑加入我们？
say:5:1826037005:1.male: Your talents would be a valuable asset to the Solitaries. Would you consider joining us?
say:5:1826037005:1.female: Your talents would be a valuable asset to the Solitaries. Would you consider joining us?

say:7:1826037007:1.text: Take your time to think about it. I'm a very patient man.
say:7:1826037007:1.source_cn: 没关系，我有足够的时间等待，请慢慢考虑吧。
say:7:1826037007:1.male: Take your time to think about it. I'm a very patient man.
say:7:1826037007:1.female: Take your time to think about it. I'm a very patient man.

choice:6:0:1.text: My talents could be put to better use.
choice:6:0:1.male: My talents could be put to better use.
choice:6:0:1.female: My talents could be put to better use.

choice:6:1:2.text: I have too many other commitments.

choice:6:1:2.female: I have too many other commitments.

say:10:1826037006:1.text: Heh. So even Merlin is not immune to the lure of gold.
say:10:1826037006:1.source_cn: 呵呵，原来金钱诱惑当前，连梅林也不能免俗。
say:10:1826037006:1.male: Heh. So even Merlin is not immune to the lure of gold.
say:10:1826037006:1.female: Heh. So even Merlin is not immune to the lure of gold.

choice:6:2:3.text: With the right offer, I might just say yes.
